description:
Interactive exploration of IMP3 results (metagenomics + metatranscriptomics), with sRNA-IMP, metaproteomics and metabolomics results as optional layers. Stand-alone tool, and the core of study portals that add their own layers and pages.

Two steps, plus an optional cohort analysis:

    export (on the HPC, needs only pandas): IMP3 sample directories → one release directory of tables (Parquet with pyarrow, else TSV.gz) + manifest.json.
    run (laptop / VM / container): the Dash app on a release directory.
    cohort (optional, HPC or laptop): cohort statistics of the release — QC and covariates, diversity, group comparisons within blocks (site), covariate-adjusted models (OLS on CLR, HC3), MAGs, mt/mg ratios — as TSVs, a PDF/HTML report and tables for the app's Cohort page. Same statistics and settings as the sRNA-IMP cohort analysis.
name: IMP-explorer
